content.short: Daily on-chain GM and contract deploys across 125+ chains, with streaks and USDC rewards.
content.description: OnChainGM turns activity on new chains into a daily habit. Users send a GM transaction or deploy a simple contract on networks from Base and Robinhood Chain to Unichain and Plasma, building streaks, badges and a place on the leaderboard. Each month a $2,000 USDC pool is shared among active users, and the site also offers a bridge, token deploys and a testnet faucet for 13 networks.
